name: Zoran Kovačić
bio:
Zoran Kovačić’s journey into motorsport finance began unconventionally, tracing back to his youth spent tinkering with engines in his uncle's Zagreb garage. While his hands were adept at mechanics, his mind excelled at numbers, leading him to a degree in economics followed by a career in corporate finance. A chance encounter with a local racing team seeking financial expertise ignited his passion, merging his love for motorsport with his professional skills. 

Zoran believes in rigorous financial discipline, demanding meticulous reporting and proactive risk management. He's known for his ability to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance, a skill honed through years of experience in various financial environments. His ambition fuels his relentless pursuit of efficiency and profitability, making him a valuable, albeit sometimes challenging, asset to any team. What sets him apart is his uncanny ability to predict market trends in the racing industry, allowing Sprint V8 to make savvy investments.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Zoran is of average height with a slightly stocky build and carries himself with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn abacus for quick calculations.
Insists on using a fountain pen for all official documents.
Secretly collects miniature racing car models.
